table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SalesMan=SM.Name,
	InvoiceCount=COUNT(S.SaleInvCode),
	SaleValue=SUM(S.NetAmt), 
	ReceivedOnInv=SUM(S.ReceivedOnInv),
	ReturnAmt = ISNULL(SUM(SR.Amt), 0),
	ChequesReceived = ISNULL(SUM(Chq.Amt), 0),
	Debits = ISNULL(SUM(Debits.Amt), 0),
	Credits = ISNULL(SUM(Credits.Amt), 0),
	Balance=SUM(S.NetAmt) - SUM(S.ReceivedOnInv) - ISNULL(SUM(SR.Amt), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Chq.Amt), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Credits.Amt), 0) + ISNULL(SUM(Debits.Amt), 0)
FROM
	SalesMan SM
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT 
		S.SaleInvCode, 
		S.SManCode, 
		NetAmt=ISNULL(SUM(InvTotal), 0), 
		ReceivedOnInv= 
			ISNULL(SUM(Amt), 0) + 
			ISNULL(SUM(CashCharged), 0) + 
			ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode), 0)
	FROM SaleLedger S 
	WHERE 
		S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.Date <= :ad_enddate AND 
		S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S.Marked='N' AND
		S.SaleCatCode IN (2) 
	GROUP BY S.SaleInvCode, S.SManCode) AS S ON (SM.SalesManCode = S.SManCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT 
		D.SaleInvCode, Amt=ISNULL(SUM(D.Amt) , 0)
	FROM 
		SRAllocationdetail D, SRAllocationHeader H 
	WHERE
		H.SRAllocationCode = D.SRAllocationCode AND
		D.SaleInvCode IN 
			(SELECT S.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S 
			WHERE S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.Date <= :ad_enddate AND 
				S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S.Marked='N' AND	S.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY D.SaleInvCode) AS SR ON (S.SaleInvCode= SR.SaleInvCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	(SELECT D.InvoiceCode, Amt=SUM(D.Amt) 
	FROM Notesdetail D, Notes H 
	WHERE  H.NoteCatCode=1 AND H.NoteCode = D.NoteCode AND
		D.InvoiceCode IN
			(SELECT S.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S 
			WHERE S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.Date <= :ad_enddate AND 
				S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S.Marked='N' AND	S.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY D.InvoiceCode) AS Chq ON (S.SaleInvCode= Chq.InvoiceCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT D.InvoiceCode, Amt=SUM(debit) 
	FROM GLdetail D, GLHeader H 
	WHERE
		H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
		H.VochCatCode IN 
			(SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V
			WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=1) AND
		D.InvoiceCode IN
			(SELECT S.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S 
			WHERE S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.Date <= :ad_enddate AND 
				S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S.Marked='N' AND	S.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY D.InvoiceCode) AS Debits ON (S.SaleInvCode= Debits.InvoiceCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT D.InvoiceCode, Amt=SUM(credit)
	FROM GLdetail D, GLHeader H 
	WHERE
		H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
		H.VochCatCode IN 
			(SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V
			WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=1) AND
		D.InvoiceCode IN
			(SELECT S.SaleInvCode FROM SaleLedger S 
			WHERE S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.Date <= :ad_enddate AND 
				S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND S.Marked='N' AND	S.SaleCatCode IN (2))
	GROUP BY D.InvoiceCode) AS Credits ON (S.SaleInvCode= Credits.InvoiceCode)
GROUP BY SM.Name
